payThen: After paying, send us the proof (a photo of the receipt): your access is extended the same day.

acc.pickText: Hello {{name}}, which store do you want to open?
acc.noStore: You have no store left. Create one to start.
acc.linkHint: Letters, numbers and dashes. It is unique.
acc.addText: You will be its owner. It has its own team and its own data, separate from your other stores.
acc.verifyNeed: First confirm your e-mail: it is what protects your stores.
acc.verifySent: Sent: open the e-mail, click the link, then come back here.
acc.signupText: {{days}}-day free trial, no card. You get an e-mail to confirm, then your store is ready.
acc.signupClosed: Sign-ups are closed for now. Contact Pilotix to open a store.
acc.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Only you know it.
acc.needTerms: Tick the box to accept the terms of use.
acc.private: Your data stays yours: the Pilotix team doesn’t see inside your store.
acc.haveAccount: I already have an account: log in
acc.checkMailText: We sent a link to {{email}}. Click it within 48 hours: your store is created right away.
acc.checkMailSpam: Nothing? Check your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.
acc.makingText: A few seconds: we’re preparing your store.
acc.haveAccountText: This e-mail already has a Pilotix account. Log in, then use “Add a store” in your account menu.
acc.verifiedText: Thank you! You can now add other stores to your account.

aide.title: Contact Pilotix
aide.sub: A question, a problem, an idea? Write to us here: the answer comes here and by e-mail.
aide.subject: Subject
aide.subjectPh: e.g. Problem with a delivery slip
aide.messagePh: Explain simply. Never write a password.
aide.privacy: The Pilotix team only sees what you write here, nothing else from your store.
